timing.ortMsMeaning: Measured interval from after generator/hash through attentionTile completion and maximum-update bookkeeping. Includes owner snapshots/validation, Tensor/native movement, ORT operations, output copies and cleanup. It is not a pure ORT MatMul/kernel timer.
timing.totalMsMeaning: Timed region starts after private references were fetched; includes operator construction, tile loop, input hashes, Hike division, comparisons and result assembly; excludes earlier reference fetch and browser launch.
timing.interpretation: Hash/generator time is diagnostic overhead for these fixtures. Ordinary model execution need not regenerate/re-hash this same KV stream for every query group; real QKV production/weights introduce different costs. Subtraction is not a verified production-speed optimization.

capacityAndTraffic.knownCallerScope: Named query/state/one K+V tile only; excludes expected arrays, ORT/Hike internals, GC, browser and other harness allocations
capacityAndTraffic.reportedCopyScope: Owner counters for admitted F32 input/output spans; cumulative traffic, not peak allocation or exhaustive ORT/native/GC copy accounting.
capacityAndTraffic.interpretation: Small selected-query fixture memory does not establish full real KV/hidden residency. The4-store design remains a planning budget until production stores, sessions, copies and other owners coexist and are measured.

allQueryWorkload.formula: 4*H*Q*K*D FLOP for QK plus AV; multiply+add counts2.
allQueryWorkload.additionalReferences: For N=65520+R the actual descriptors and queries/keys both expand. FLOP ratio relative to65520 is ((65520+R)/65520)^2; this is arithmetic, not measured runtime scaling.
